render_engine: Blender 5.2 LTS EEVEE previews; Cycles optional selectively after benchmark
claims: US$1.09 per 1000 eligible verified approved views is an illustrative offered CPM, not observed net revenue
100000 eligible views would imply approx US$109 gross before fees and only if funds, caps and approval allow

shots.title: The count breaks reality
shots.action: Phone in a dark tactile studio; count rises toward 100,000 then the glass bulges as physical metallic digits push from the screen
shots.camera: 65mm macro, slow 12cm push, shallow rack-focus to screen; never rotate arbitrarily
shots.transition: Last frame metallic digits at lens fills next shot
shots.sound: Two vibration taps, short low sub rise; first spoken hook
shots.caption: 100,000 VISTAS
shots.quality: Recognizable phone/count and impossible event within 2 seconds

shots.title: The camera follows the explosion
shots.action: Metal objects/coins spill from phone with a believable floor contact and scattered reflections; tracking camera follows one minted token
shots.camera: 35mm perspective, quick motivated chase, physical acceleration and safe handheld stabilization
shots.transition: Follow the same hero coin across shot boundary
shots.sound: Coin clusters, textured whoosh, momentum hits exactly as coin crosses frame
shots.caption: ¿Y cuánto pagan?
shots.quality: Coin movement has mass; reflections, motion blur and shadows are coherent

shots.title: The $109 conditional reveal
shots.action: Coin spins into light, engraved $109 BRUTOS* appears; visible smaller 'ejemplo sujeto a elegibilidad' in a readable safe region
shots.camera: 85mm macro/rack focus; restrained rotation and believable studio light sweep
shots.transition: Coin surface shape and warm highlight become embossed seal on next receipt
shots.sound: Delicate metal ring; lower music for number and caveat
shots.caption: US$109 BRUTOS* / EJEMPLO
shots.quality: No false assertion of real payout; rate context legible and linked in caption

shots.title: Payment terms become the story
shots.action: Coin transforms into paper statement with clear fields: rate example US$1.09/1K eligible; 100K accepted views; cap/approval applies. Hand-style stamp is visually implied without impersonating a platform
shots.camera: 60mm shoulder-level product shot, parallax across paper fibers, motivated pan following receipt
shots.transition: Receipt flips end-over-end, same framing for rejected version
shots.sound: Paper drag + quiet stamp; voice explains eligibility
shots.caption: SOLO SI CALIFICA
shots.quality: No proprietary platform UI spoofing; terms simplified without misrepresentation

shots.title: The twist: rejected video pays zero
shots.action: Reverse flips printed statement to NOT APPROVED; brass token fractures into fragments settling on floor; $0 payout visible
shots.camera: 35mm lateral whip then lock to falling fragments, depth of field carries the punchline
shots.transition: Fragments and floor reflection compress into glow of phone screen
shots.sound: Hard paper crack and low bass drop; drop music to emphasize zero
shots.caption: NO APROBADO = US$0
shots.quality: Rejected payout framed as possible outcome, not universal; debris physics plausible

shots.title: Return to the phone; seamless loop
shots.action: Fragments pull back into phone, count glows, simple phrase 'Vistas no son ganancias', Sovtiva mark for less than 1.2 seconds, return image matches shot A opening
shots.camera: 60mm slow return to original macro camera position; matched loop framing
shots.transition: Last frame visually matches shot A frame 0 for replay
shots.sound: One resolving chime, original recorded VO line, music transition loops
shots.caption: VISTAS ≠ GANANCIAS
shots.quality: Viewers understand before CTA; final loop seamless and brand doesn't dominate
